units.source_text: [\[14\]](#part1330.html#w14) 贯之姓纪，亦十世纪中名歌人，

en.t: [14] Tsurayuki's surname was Ki, and he was also a famous poet of the tenth century.

units.source_text: 曾与纪友则、凡河内躬恒、壬生忠岑编撰《古今和歌集》。

en.t: He once compiled the Kokin Wakashu together with Ki no Tomonori, Oshikochi no Mitsune, and Mibu no Tadamine.
